shared_elements: raised ridge-like modelling of features (brow/limb ridges)
justification: A depicts a single frontal human face reduced to a few broad ridges (brows, nose, mouth), while B depicts a repertoire of animals — a bird in profile, snake-like and quadruped forms — plus a horizontal band of repeated angular signs arranged in registers on a shaft. The only correspondence is the shared taste for heavily schematic, ridge-modelled figuration; there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
